Raw Al, Cr, Fe, Ni, Mo, and Si pellets with purity ≥ 99.9 wt% were melt to prepare the Fe36Ni36Cr10Mo1Al17−XSiX ... alloys. To achieve chemical homogeneity, the alloy samples were remelted 4 times and each time kept for 5 min under electromagnetic stirring.
The obtained alloys specimens with dimensions of 60 mm × 12 mm × 5 mm were then rolled ~ 20% and recrystallized at 1200 °C for 20 min, followed by water quenching.

mechanisms.name: grain boundary and phase boundary pinning by Si-rich phase

evidence.quote: the enhanced performance stemmed from the strengthened boundaries with Si-rich phase, which played an important role in pinning grain and phase boundaries to hinder their sliding during high-temperature deformation
The rapid reduction of the strength and increase of the elongation was originated from the rapid softening of the B2 phase at 800 °C compared with that of FCC phase.
